notes.title: FINALLY!!! The INITIAL FULL RELEASE is here! - v1.0.0 of Booom-Slang!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263814/1e9086e154840f6a955350aa71aa02561ace8dff.png[/img]

Hi everyone!

It's finally here, I know it's been crazy long, but I finally have the Initial Full Release for Booom-Slang! done and it is now released and available on Steam.

Please keep in mind that there are still 1 or 2 small issues here and there that I need to attend to and tweaks that I would like to make that I will be getting in via patches within the next month or so and then I will be jumping on the additional post release content for the game such as more maps, modes and features.

Also, please keep in mind the game currently ONLY SUPPORTS CONTROLLER for now and I am busy working on Keyboard and Mouse support, apologies, as a Local/Party Multi-player game mainly with the aim for multi-platform, controller support was the easiest way I could get the core experience polished in time.

Please, any and all support would be immensely appreciated for the release, as a full time, solo indie developer in South Africa that depends on all of you in order to support my family I am always so grateful for everything that all of you give in support, truly, I wouldn't be here without all of you.

I hope all of you enjoy Booom-Slang! and I can't wait to show all of you what I have planned for the post release content updates. 

Also please share your streams, clips and screenshots I would love to see what bonkers battles all of you and your friends get yourselves into, hahaha!

Thanks again everyone :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263814/008aed0962f229223a670f78bddc2289ed26bb1e.png[/img]

notes.title: BIG UPDATE!!! v0.5 Now Available. Adding Mutators, Score Board and a new Arena!
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

Hope you are all doing okay, I just wanted to let everyone know that the latest update for Operation: BoomSlang! is now available and adds a few great BIG new features to the game.

Mutators and Match Settings have been added to the Couch Party (Local Multiplayer) mode of the game which allow player to set the match according to their liking and set a vast amount of settings to tweak the match their unique preference.

A Score Board System has been added to give a full sense of accomplishment and achievement for each Multiplayer match played, additionally players will also be awarded with match achievement relevant badges that co-ordinate with their playing strategy.

A new Arena has been added to the Couch Party mode, titled Terrifying Tundra, an Ice and Snow themed Arena with a unique and cool layout design. 

Along with this there are a few bug fixes, tweaks and fine-tunings that should provide for a more overall enjoyable experience.

Hope everyone enjoys the latest update and the new content and can't wait to hear what everyone thinks.

Thank you again so much for all the support so far everyone, I truly appreciate it :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263814/008aed0962f229223a670f78bddc2289ed26bb1e.png[/img]

notes.title: v0.1.3 NOW AVAILABLE! New Bug Fixes + Experimental Mouse Control for SP
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263814/8c6a316bf1e4267688989e21e81cf94ae64d4427.png[/img]

Hey everyone,

Just wanted to let everyone know that v0.1.3 is NOW AVAILABLE and bring in a bunch of General Bug Fixes, including the Close Proximity Hit Detection Bug and the Creeps no longer box the Player in and keep a bit of a less claustrophobic distance.

Additionally, I am trying to get Mouse Control working and fine tuned, there is a new Experimental Mouse Control Option for the Single Player Mode by Pressing BackSpace on your Keyboard during a Single-Player Survival Round or pressing the "Select/View/Share" button on your Joystick (this can obviously also be changed in the button mapping menu). Please just keep in mind that the cursor makes the player's aiming go off-center if the cursor moves to close to the player character while moving (I am still trying to fix this issue).

I hope that the game flow and feel is better now with the new fixes and improvements and I cant wait to hear what everyone thinks!

Thank you again so much for all the support and feedback so far everyone, I can't do this without you :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263814/96629bccca1b11cd892d6266679e8a5ee5204673.png[/img]

notes.title: v0.1.2 is NOW AVAILABLE! Big Input and User Interface improvements and fixes!
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

Sorry for the delay, v0.1.2 is finally available and it brings huge new Input and UI Impovements, along with some great tweaks and fixes.

- Keyboard + Mouse Gameplay should be basically playable now and not cause anymore Menu issues, although I still need to finetune and tweak the sensitivity and smoothness for Mouse Aiming and maybe switch it to Cursor Position instead to make it fully comfortable.

- Lot's of User Interface and Menu fixes and improvements.

- Rectifying of some other Game Breaking Bugs.

- A few tweaks and improvements on some of the gameplay.

Please stay tuned more updates coming soon, the next one should be a BIG one ;)

Sorry again for all the hassle everyone, hope this update fixes most of the issues that you might have encountered. Please let me know if you run into anything else and what you think?

Thank you again for all the support and feedback so far, it truly means a lot and I won't be able to perfect and polish this game without your help!

Keep being awesome :)
